statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail eases within the low band because the U.S. cash open resolved into two-way trade rather than continuation: NQ has set no new session high since the auction, QQQ trades below its opening print, and VIX is making new lows for the day. Attention narrows to the closing hour.
recommendation: Conditional attention concentrates in the narrow 19:00-20:00 UTC New York closing hour, the last full-liquidity window before Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote on Aug 28 at 14:00 UTC, which falls outside this forecast horizon. The 15:00 UTC Kansas City Fed survey is a minor second-tier checkpoint. Outside those windows the mapped state returns to the calm baseline that has governed since the overnight hours. Tail remains well below the block threshold and no forecast hour in the next 24 crosses it. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain unchanged.
headline: Cash open digests the Nvidia gap without extending: NQ holds 29,534 below the overnight high and Tail eases to 12
body: Nasdaq-100 futures trade near 29,534, up 244.50 points or 0.83% against the 29,289.50 prior settlement, roughly 45 minutes into the U.S. cash session. The decisive evidence is what the opening auction did not do. The session range remains 29,401.75-29,662.00, the same band established overnight: full-liquidity trade has produced no new session high and no break of the low. Price sits about 100 points below the high and 130 above the low, holding neither extreme. QQQ tells the same story in cash: it opened at 716.98, printed 718.47, then faded to a 715.00 low and trades at 715.78, below its own opening level. An opening auction that fades rather than extends is the direct opposite of the shallow-pullback, repeated-extension signature that Tail measures, and it is the single most informative observation available since the prior assessment. Volatility confirms it. VIX trades at 14.95, down 1.71%, inside a 14.80-14.98 range that is making new lows for the day against a 15.21 prior close; there is no hedging bid into the open at all. The curve gives no confirmation either: 2Y and 10Y constant maturities were last published at 4.17% and 4.64% on the Federal Reserve H.15 release, and Treasury futures were effectively unchanged across the curve overnight. WTI is near $82.85, up 0.75%, with Brent at $89.06, up 1.39%, on Russian export disruption set against improving Strait of Hormuz supply prospects; the Middle East backdrop remains the managed-disruption regime that has been in place for months rather than a new discontinuity. Cross-asset breadth stays dispersed. Cash indices lag the futures gap, with the Dow up 0.1%, the S&P 500 up 0.3% and the Nasdaq Composite up 0.6% at the open. Nvidia leads at roughly 6% after fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $96.2 billion, Data Center sales of $89 billion and guidance near $108 billion for the current quarter, while Apple and Microsoft trade lower. The advance is broader than a single name today: Salesforce jumped over 20% on raised guidance, CrowdStrike about 18% on record net new annual recurring revenue of $333 million, and Okta over 19%, so software joins semiconductors in leadership. That broadening lifts participation without producing index-level directional efficiency, which is why the dominant mode is assessed as mixed rather than trend-up. Macro was second-tier and already digested: initial jobless claims for the week to Aug 22 printed 203,000 against a 208,000 consensus, continuing claims 1,778,000 against 1,811,000, and the advance goods trade balance came in at -$118.8 billion versus -$100 billion expected, none of which moved rates or volatility. The forward policy backdrop remains the main source of elevated Stress. Kansas City Fed President Schmid said on the eve of the symposium that the Fed has not achieved its 2% goal and that the current rate is very accommodating. Fed Chair Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole keynote as chair on Aug 28 at 14:00 UTC, alongside Chicago PMI and the preliminary payroll benchmark revision, all beyond this 24-hour horizon, so they widen outcome dispersion inside the window without supplying observed path evidence.

lookbackSummary: The past 24 hours span the Nvidia release and its complete digestion. From 14:00 UTC on Aug 26 the regime was mixed and calm, with Tail decaying from 14 to 10 through the afternoon while Stress climbed from 54 to 61 as positioning built into the report. The 20:00 UTC release hour was the only non-green hour in the window, moving to WATCH/yellow at Tail 21 and Stress 66. Futures reopened at 22:00 UTC on the beat and raised outlook, and the assessment stepped down through 18 and 16 in event/whipsaw mode as the gap held without extending. Through the Asian and European hours the regime returned to mixed at Tail 10-11 with Stress easing to 45-47, the calmest stretch of the window, and the 12:00 UTC hour held Tail 10 into the jobless-claims release. The 13:00 UTC hour lifted to Tail 14 and Stress 54 ahead of the cash open. Three hours are unavailable because no assessment was published for them: 21:00 UTC on Aug 26 during the futures maintenance break, and 00:00 and 09:00 UTC on Aug 27. The mapped state was EA_ON/green for every available hour except the release hour.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours contain one modest checkpoint inside the window and one large catalyst just beyond it. With the cash open now resolved into two-way trade, conditional Tail sits at 11-12 across the U.S. afternoon, carrying only the 15:00 UTC Kansas City Fed survey. The narrow attention window is the 19:00-20:00 UTC closing hour, where conditional Tail lifts to 14 for position squaring, month-end rebalancing and closing imbalances ahead of Friday. After the cash close the estimate steps down, with the 21:00 UTC maintenance break the structural low at 9, and holds at the 10-11 overnight floor through Asian hours in normal mode. From the 07:00 UTC European open the path drifts up through 12-14 as the keynote countdown compresses positioning, reaching 16 in the final 13:00 UTC slot, where the Friday cash open, Chicago PMI and the keynote itself cluster. Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote at 14:00 UTC on Aug 28, Chicago PMI at 13:45 UTC and the preliminary payroll benchmark revision all fall at or after the edge of this window, so their weight appears as rising Stress and widening dispersion rather than as an asserted price path. Every hour maps to EA_ON/green; the estimate declines to assert direction ahead of an unprinted release.

Conditional risk holds near the baseline unless yields start confirming an equity leg, which neither the overnight nor the morning tape has shown.

Afternoon Treasury supply is a routine checkpoint, not an index catalyst

forecast.analysis: Second afternoon hour, ahead of the closing stretch. Conditional risk stays at the baseline. The question that matters here is whether the day's software and semiconductor leadership broadens or narrows into the close, since a narrow advance normally preserves internal mean reversion.

forecast.analysis: Cash close at 20:00 UTC, after which futures continue alone into a thinning book. Conditional risk steps back down as the auction that concentrates flow completes. Post-close futures moves on light volume are typically noise rather than the persistent structure Tail measures.

Post-close futures liquidity thins sharply

forecast.analysis: The CME maintenance break covers most of this hour, so tradable exposure is structurally minimal and this is the low point of the forecast path. Conditional Tail and Stress both step down mechanically rather than on any change in the underlying evidence.
drivers: CME futures maintenance break covers most of 21:00-22:00 UTC
Structural liquidity halt, not an evidence-based change in regime

forecast.analysis: Futures reopen into a thin book with no scheduled catalyst. Twenty-four hours earlier this same hour carried the Nvidia reopen; tonight it carries nothing comparable, so the conditional baseline is the quiet overnight regime rather than a repeat of that gap.
drivers: Futures reopen with no scheduled earnings or macro catalyst tonight
Contrast with Aug 26, when this hour reopened on the Nvidia release
Thin-book baseline assumes no fresh overnight headline

forecast.analysis: Late U.S. evening, ahead of Asia. Conditional risk holds at the overnight floor. The path assumption is continuation of orderly two-way trade, with no scheduled release due until the European morning.
drivers: No scheduled U.S. or Asian macro release in this hour
Overnight floor assumes the U.S. session closed without one-way structure

forecast.analysis: Tokyo morning. Asian cash markets take their first read on the U.S. software and semiconductor session. Conditional risk is marginally above the overnight floor because a regional handover can reprice sentiment, though such moves rarely establish index-level NQ path structure.

Regional handovers reprice sentiment but rarely set NQ path structure

forecast.analysis: Asian session active. Conditional risk holds just above the floor, with semiconductor supply-chain names in Tokyo, Taipei and Seoul the relevant read-through channel from Nvidia's report. A one-way NQ path from this hour would require an amplifier that is not currently scheduled.
drivers: Asian semiconductor complex is the read-through channel from Nvidia
No scheduled catalyst capable of producing NQ one-way structure

drivers: Mid-Asian hours are typically the quietest NQ liquidity of the cycle

forecast.analysis: Asia into its afternoon. Conditional risk stays at the floor. Confidence begins to taper across the overnight slots because the live price-path evidence supporting this assessment ages with every hour beyond the cutoff.

forecast.analysis: Approaching the Asian close. Conditional risk holds at the floor with no scheduled U.S. macro in the hour. The next meaningful checkpoint is the European handover, where positioning for Friday's Jackson Hole keynote typically starts to become visible.

forecast.analysis: Pre-European hours. Conditional Stress edges up as the countdown to the Friday keynote shortens, while conditional Tail stays at the floor: an approaching scheduled event raises outcome dispersion, not observed directional efficiency.
drivers: Keynote countdown lifts conditional Stress without lifting Tail
Scheduled events raise dispersion, not observed directional efficiency

forecast.analysis: European pre-open. Conditional risk lifts marginally as continental futures and cash books begin to build depth. Any gap carried into this hour would face its first genuine liquidity test at the 07:00 UTC European cash open rather than here.

forecast.analysis: European cash open at 09:00 Berlin. Conditional mode returns to mixed as cross-asset volumes normalise and the Friday session starts pricing the keynote. Conditional risk is a step above the overnight floor but remains well inside the low band.

Mode returns to mixed as cross-asset participation normalises

forecast.analysis: European morning. Conditional Stress continues to build on keynote positioning while conditional Tail holds. Pre-event positioning and forecast dispersion belong in Stress; Tail would move only on price-path evidence that cannot exist before the event prints.

European morning volume gives a first read on Friday risk appetite

forecast.analysis: Mid-European morning. Conditional risk holds. The most useful checkpoint in this hour is whether the volatility complex begins bidding into the keynote: a VIX that stays near the mid-14s argues against a hedging build, while a sustained lift would raise conditional Stress further.
drivers: Volatility-complex behaviour into the keynote is this hour's checkpoint
VIX holding near the mid-14s would argue against a hedging build

forecast.analysis: European midday, four hours before the keynote. Conditional risk drifts up as the event window approaches and liquidity providers typically widen quotes. This is a countdown effect on dispersion rather than an assertion that directional structure will be present.
drivers: Countdown effect widens spreads and raises conditional dispersion
Drift reflects event proximity, not asserted directional structure

forecast.analysis: Late European morning. Conditional risk holds its elevated drift into the U.S. premarket handover. Nothing in the currently verified evidence supports a higher conditional Tail here; the estimate declines to price a keynote outcome that has not occurred.
drivers: Estimate declines to price an unprinted keynote outcome
Conditional drift holds into the U.S. premarket handover

forecast.analysis: U.S. premarket, roughly two hours before the keynote and 90 minutes before the Friday cash open. Conditional Stress reaches its highest level of the forecast as positioning concentrates. Conditional Tail stays in the low band because no event has printed and no path evidence exists for that hour.

Chicago PMI at 13:45 UTC and the keynote at 14:00 UTC follow this hour

forecast.analysis: Final forecast slot: the Friday cash open at 13:30 UTC, Chicago PMI at 13:45 UTC and, immediately beyond this horizon, Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote at 14:00 UTC. Conditional mode shifts to event/whipsaw for clustered unpriced outcomes. Conditional Tail stays inside the low band.
